thread:
maria_guerrero: Kickoff for SummitPay migration POC. They want a drop-in that keeps existing client code (VendorX /v1/respond) with minimal prompt edits. Core asks: prompt parity, predictable billing during cutover, and security attestation. Timeline: 10 business days.

lenard_kim: quick clarifying q: do they want a temporary flat per-call price during the POC or a long-term pricing change? we should prepare both.

maria_guerrero: POC: they asked for a flat per-call migration rate for 30 days to avoid token-billing surprises. Long-term they will evaluate token rates.

ravi_shah: Proposed technical plan (short):
1) shim service that accepts VendorX envelope and forwards to /v1/chat.complete on Redwood.
2) deterministic test harness: temp=0, top_p=1, seed-lock if available.
3) normalization layer to remove vendor headers/trace ids and canonicalize whitespace/quotes.
4) run 1k-sample A/B and produce semantic similarity + token delta report.

ravi_shah: Example shim mapping to share with SummitPay devs:
```
# VendorX incoming
POST /v1/respond
{ "input": "Explain charges for acct 123", "limit": 120 }
# shim -> Redwood
POST /v1/chat.complete
{ "model": "redwood-chat-1", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Explain charges for acct 123"}], "max_tokens": 120, "temperature": 0 }
```
This preserves shape and enforces deterministic sampling.

lenard_kim: For the 30-day flat price I'll need: average tokens / call estimate and peak QPS. can we get 3 representative samples (low/med/high) and a rough token-count?

maria_guerrero: Uploaded 3 samples to the drive: sample_low.txt (~36 tokens), sample_med.txt (~210 tokens), sample_high.txt (~870 tokens) per VendorX tokenization. Expect Redwood tokenization to be within +/-10-25% in many cases.

talia_ng: Security pre-checks:
- EU data residency required? summitpay is EU-first, yes. need EU-staged infra or Private.
- VPC peering / TLS + mutual auth for POC.
- KMS BYOK support? they asked for CMK in Azure Key Vault.
- DPA and export restrictions.
I'll prepare the questionnaire answers and list of docs (SOC2, ISO). Need contact at SummitPay security to sign the SAs.

ravi_shah: Token accounting note: VendorX includes padding tokens in their usage calc for historical reasons. When we tokenize sample_high, we saw VendorX billed ~940 tokens, Redwood raw tokenize=878. But Redwood generation produced ~920 tokens output due to different system messages. We'll include both prompt+completion token breakdown in report.

maria_guerrero: Good. Also they flagged subtle formatting differences (dates, currency symbols) causing parity tests to fail. We should add a post-processing step to normalize locale formatting before diff.

lenard_kim: On the flat-rate: propose $0.015 per call during 30-day cutover for up to 250k calls, then revert to token billing. I'll draft and circulate with finance.

talia_ng: Operational blocker: SummitPay requires audit log retention for 12 months and per-request correlation IDs forwarded to their syslog. Can our logging pipeline forward request metadata to customer syslog for POC?

ravi_shah: We can export a filtered audit stream to their syslog via syslog-ng connector in staging. we'll need allowlisted IPs.

deploy-bot: staging env "summitpay-poc" provisioned in eu-west-1. firewall rules pending.

maria_guerrero: Can we smoke on Friday morning EU window (08:00-10:00 CET)? SummitPay prefers early slot.

ravi_shah: Friday smoke ok. I'll open a short maintenance window and post deploy steps.

lenard_kim: I'll finalize the flat-rate quote and include a token-comparison sheet (3 samples + projected monthly spend at their current qps).

talia_ng: I'll attach SOC2 cert and a note about KMS BYOK feasibility. Also raising DPA + EU data residency to legal.

maria_guerrero: Action items: 1) ravi: PR for shim + harness; 2) lenard: flat-rate quote + token compare; 3) talia: security Qs + docs; 4) infra: finalize allowlist and syslog export. Meeting scheduled Fri 08:30 CET.

ravi_shah: Will push PR and test results by Thu EOD.

maria_guerrero: Thanks team. I'll inform SummitPay and send calendar invite. Any other blockers?

talia_ng: One more blocker: if they insist on Azure KV CMK and EU-only key storage, we may need Private or Dedicated. flagging in the thread.

maria_guerrero: Noted. We'll surface options during the sync. Marking thread active.
